# Optional MS2PIP environment for the desktop application.
#
# Separate from env/console-requirements.txt for historical reasons: ms2pip==4.0.0
# needed sqlalchemy<2 while deeplc==4.1.1 needs sqlalchemy>=2. Since 4.2.0 the pair
# resolves in one environment (env/mumdia-deeplc.yml is exactly that), so this file
# exists only because the application still installs MS2PIP as a separate optional
# component; folding it into the primary environment is a desktop follow-up.
#
# Needed only for FASTA-mode library building with predicted fragment intensities.
#
# 4.2.0 is the version the FASTA-mode measurements were made with (docs/28 section 22).
ms2pip==4.2.0
